before.d: 나이지리아 설화에 등장하는 Spirit. The Nago are a nanchon of lwa in Haitian Vodou. The Nago are religious syncretization of the orisha…
before.sh: 나이지리아 설화에 등장하는 Spirit. The Nago are a nanchon of lwa in Hait
before.ip: Nago lwa(Nago lwa) — 전설 기반 Spirit IP. 판타지/드라마 장르.

after.d: The Nago lwa are a group of spirits in Haitian Vodou, rooted in Yoruba religious traditions brought to Haiti. They are associated with powerful warrior figures, including many forms of Ogou.
after.sh: 아이티의 나고 로아 전승을 바탕으로 전사의 의무와 공동체의 기억을 다루는 이야기.
after.ip: Nago lwa(Nago lwa) — 전설 기반 Spirit IP. 판타지/드라마 장르.

reason: Source identifies Haitian Vodou; Yoruba category inheritance incorrectly assigned Nigeria.
Correct mistranscribed proper names against the source; Ninhinuna must not become Ninhursag.
Remove the unpublished duplicate left in the original country during reassignment.
